shortDescription: Update the iDRAC network settings on the specified host.

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default.

options.name: dhcp_enabled
options.description: Whether DHCP service enabled or not.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway address of the iDRAC.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: The MAC address of the iDRAC.

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: The IPv6 address of the iDRAC.

options.name: ipv6_auto_config_enabled
options.description: Whether enable auto config iDRAC IPv6 address or not.

options.name: ipv6_gateway
options.description: The gateway address of the iDRAC IPv6 address.

options.name: ipv6_prefix_length
options.description: The prefix length of the iDRAC IPv6 address.

options.name: sn
options.description: The serial number of the host to be queried.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting request id, the default value is 300 seconds.

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to.

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The VLAN ID setting of the iDRAC. Set 0 to disable.

options.name: vlan_priority
options.description: The VLAN priority setting of the iDRAC. The default value is 0.

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System.
